package domain

import (
	"errors"
	"strings"
)

const (
	TeacherLearningReadinessRequestSchema = "learning-readiness-request.v1"
	TeacherLearningReadinessSchema        = "learning-readiness.v1"
	TeacherLearningReadinessResolver      = "learning-readiness-resolver-v1"
	TeacherLearningReadinessScope         = "PUBLISHED_GRAPH_RESOLUTION"
	TeacherLearningContentNotCreated      = "NOT_CREATED"
)

const (
	TeacherLearningReadinessReady              = "READY"
	TeacherLearningReadinessNotReady           = "NOT_READY"
	TeacherLearningReadinessNeedsClarification = "NEEDS_CLARIFICATION"
)

const (
	TeacherReadinessReasonFoundationGraphResolved   = "FOUNDATION_GRAPH_RESOLVED"
	TeacherReadinessReasonGoBackendGraphResolved    = "GO_BACKEND_GRAPH_RESOLVED"
	TeacherReadinessReasonActivePathExists          = "ACTIVE_PATH_EXISTS"
	TeacherReadinessReasonStudentStateMissing       = "STUDENT_STATE_MISSING"
	TeacherReadinessReasonLearningIntentMissing     = "LEARNING_INTENT_MISSING"
	TeacherReadinessReasonProfileIncomplete         = "PROFILE_INCOMPLETE"
	TeacherReadinessReasonDesiredStacksUnresolved   = "DESIRED_STACKS_UNRESOLVED"
	TeacherReadinessReasonMultipleDesiredStacks     = "MULTIPLE_DESIRED_STACKS"
	TeacherReadinessReasonProfileContradictory      = "PROFILE_CONTRADICTORY"
	TeacherReadinessReasonContentLanguageUntrusted  = "CONTENT_LANGUAGE_UNTRUSTED"
	TeacherReadinessReasonProfileUnsupported        = "PROFILE_COMBINATION_UNSUPPORTED"
	TeacherReadinessReasonPublishedGraphUnavailable = "PUBLISHED_GRAPH_UNAVAILABLE"
)

const (
	TeacherReadinessStateNone      = "none"
	TeacherReadinessStateDraft     = "accepted_draft"
	TeacherReadinessStateFinalized = "finalized_profile"

	TeacherFoundationGoalCode        = "programming.foundation"
	TeacherFoundationGoalVersion     = "v1"
	TeacherFoundationGraphVersion    = "programming-foundation-graph-v1"
	TeacherGoBackendGoalCode         = "go.backend"
	TeacherGoBackendGoalVersion      = "v1"
	TeacherGoBackendGraphVersion     = "go-backend-graph-v1"
	TeacherFoundationGoalDisplayName = "Основы программирования"
	TeacherGoBackendGoalDisplayName  = "Go backend"
)

var (
	ErrTeacherLearningReadinessUnavailable = errors.New("teacher learning readiness unavailable")
	ErrTeacherLearningReadinessStale       = errors.New("teacher learning readiness student state changed")
)

// TeacherStudentReadinessStateRef is the exact Student-owned snapshot fence.
// Teacher may copy it between Student receipts, Planner reads, and its public
// session DTO, but never derives profile or graph data from it.
type TeacherStudentReadinessStateRef struct {
	Kind    string `json:"kind"`
	Version int64  `json:"version"`
}

type TeacherLearningReadinessRequest struct {
	Schema           string                           `json:"schema"`
	ExpectedStateRef *TeacherStudentReadinessStateRef `json:"expected_state_ref,omitempty"`
}

type TeacherLearningReadinessGoal struct {
	Code         string `json:"code"`
	Version      string `json:"version"`
	GraphVersion string `json:"graph_version"`
}

// TeacherLearningReadinessActivePath is observational only. Its identifiers
// are validated and then deliberately never placed in user-visible copy/UI.
type TeacherLearningReadinessActivePath struct {
	LearningPathID string `json:"learning_path_id"`
	Version        int64  `json:"version"`
	CourseID       string `json:"course_id"`
	GoalCode       string `json:"goal_code"`
	Status         string `json:"status"`
}

type TeacherLearningReadiness struct {
	Schema          string                              `json:"schema"`
	Result          string                              `json:"result"`
	ReasonCodes     []string                            `json:"reason_codes"`
	ResolverVersion string                              `json:"resolver_version"`
	StateRef        TeacherStudentReadinessStateRef     `json:"state_ref"`
	ReadinessScope  string                              `json:"readiness_scope"`
	Executable      bool                                `json:"executable"`
	ContentStatus   string                              `json:"content_status"`
	Goal            *TeacherLearningReadinessGoal       `json:"goal,omitempty"`
	ActivePath      *TeacherLearningReadinessActivePath `json:"active_path,omitempty"`
}

func NormalizeTeacherStudentReadinessStateRef(input TeacherStudentReadinessStateRef) (TeacherStudentReadinessStateRef, error) {
	if strings.TrimSpace(input.Kind) != input.Kind {
		return TeacherStudentReadinessStateRef{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	switch input.Kind {
	case TeacherReadinessStateNone:
		if input.Version != 0 {
			return TeacherStudentReadinessStateRef{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
		}
	case TeacherReadinessStateDraft, TeacherReadinessStateFinalized:
		if input.Version < 1 {
			return TeacherStudentReadinessStateRef{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
		}
	default:
		return TeacherStudentReadinessStateRef{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	return input, nil
}

func TeacherReadinessStateRefFromOnboarding(state TeacherStudentOnboardingState, studentID string) (TeacherStudentReadinessStateRef, error) {
	normalized, err := NormalizeTeacherStudentOnboardingState(state, studentID)
	if err != nil {
		return TeacherStudentReadinessStateRef{}, err
	}
	switch normalized.Draft.Status {
	case StudentOnboardingDraftDraft:
		if normalized.Draft.Version == 0 {
			return TeacherStudentReadinessStateRef{Kind: TeacherReadinessStateNone, Version: 0}, nil
		}
		return TeacherStudentReadinessStateRef{Kind: TeacherReadinessStateDraft, Version: normalized.Draft.Version}, nil
	case StudentOnboardingDraftCompleted:
		if normalized.ProfileVersion < 1 {
			return TeacherStudentReadinessStateRef{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
		}
		return TeacherStudentReadinessStateRef{Kind: TeacherReadinessStateFinalized, Version: normalized.ProfileVersion}, nil
	default:
		return TeacherStudentReadinessStateRef{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
}

func NormalizeTeacherLearningReadiness(input TeacherLearningReadiness, expected *TeacherStudentReadinessStateRef) (TeacherLearningReadiness, error) {
	if strings.TrimSpace(input.Schema) != input.Schema || strings.TrimSpace(input.Result) != input.Result ||
		strings.TrimSpace(input.ResolverVersion) != input.ResolverVersion || strings.TrimSpace(input.ReadinessScope) != input.ReadinessScope ||
		strings.TrimSpace(input.ContentStatus) != input.ContentStatus {
		return TeacherLearningReadiness{}, ErrTeacherLearningReadinessUnavailable
	}
	stateRef, err := NormalizeTeacherStudentReadinessStateRef(input.StateRef)
	if err != nil || input.Schema != TeacherLearningReadinessSchema || input.ResolverVersion != TeacherLearningReadinessResolver ||
		input.ReadinessScope != TeacherLearningReadinessScope || input.Executable || input.ContentStatus != TeacherLearningContentNotCreated ||
		len(input.ReasonCodes) != 1 {
		return TeacherLearningReadiness{}, ErrTeacherLearningReadinessUnavailable
	}
	input.StateRef = stateRef
	if expected != nil {
		normalizedExpected, expectedErr := NormalizeTeacherStudentReadinessStateRef(*expected)
		if expectedErr != nil || normalizedExpected != stateRef {
			return TeacherLearningReadiness{}, ErrTeacherLearningReadinessStale
		}
	}
	reason := input.ReasonCodes[0]
	if strings.TrimSpace(reason) != reason {
		return TeacherLearningReadiness{}, ErrTeacherLearningReadinessUnavailable
	}
	switch input.Result {
	case TeacherLearningReadinessReady:
		if input.ActivePath != nil || input.Goal == nil || !validReadyGoal(reason, *input.Goal) {
			return TeacherLearningReadiness{}, ErrTeacherLearningReadinessUnavailable
		}
	case TeacherLearningReadinessNeedsClarification:
		if input.Goal != nil || input.ActivePath != nil || !clarificationReason(reason) {
			return TeacherLearningReadiness{}, ErrTeacherLearningReadinessUnavailable
		}
	case TeacherLearningReadinessNotReady:
		if input.Goal != nil || !notReadyReason(reason) ||
			(reason == TeacherReadinessReasonActivePathExists) != (input.ActivePath != nil) {
			return TeacherLearningReadiness{}, ErrTeacherLearningReadinessUnavailable
		}
		if input.ActivePath != nil && !validReadinessActivePath(*input.ActivePath) {
			return TeacherLearningReadiness{}, ErrTeacherLearningReadinessUnavailable
		}
	default:
		return TeacherLearningReadiness{}, ErrTeacherLearningReadinessUnavailable
	}
	return input, nil
}

func validReadyGoal(reason string, goal TeacherLearningReadinessGoal) bool {
	switch reason {
	case TeacherReadinessReasonFoundationGraphResolved:
		return goal.Code == TeacherFoundationGoalCode && goal.Version == TeacherFoundationGoalVersion && goal.GraphVersion == TeacherFoundationGraphVersion
	case TeacherReadinessReasonGoBackendGraphResolved:
		return goal.Code == TeacherGoBackendGoalCode && goal.Version == TeacherGoBackendGoalVersion && goal.GraphVersion == TeacherGoBackendGraphVersion
	default:
		return false
	}
}

func clarificationReason(reason string) bool {
	switch reason {
	case TeacherReadinessReasonStudentStateMissing, TeacherReadinessReasonLearningIntentMissing,
		TeacherReadinessReasonProfileIncomplete, TeacherReadinessReasonDesiredStacksUnresolved,
		TeacherReadinessReasonMultipleDesiredStacks, TeacherReadinessReasonProfileContradictory,
		TeacherReadinessReasonContentLanguageUntrusted:
		return true
	default:
		return false
	}
}

func notReadyReason(reason string) bool {
	return reason == TeacherReadinessReasonActivePathExists || reason == TeacherReadinessReasonProfileUnsupported || reason == TeacherReadinessReasonPublishedGraphUnavailable
}

func validReadinessActivePath(input TeacherLearningReadinessActivePath) bool {
	return validUUID(input.LearningPathID) && input.Version >= 1 && validUUID(input.CourseID) &&
		validReadinessCode(input.GoalCode) && input.Status == "ACTIVE"
}

func validReadinessCode(input string) bool {
	if input == "" || len(input) > 64 || strings.TrimSpace(input) != input {
		return false
	}
	for index, current := range input {
		if (current >= 'a' && current <= 'z') || (current >= '0' && current <= '9') || (index > 0 && (current == '.' || current == '_' || current == '-')) {
			continue
		}
		return false
	}
	return true
}
